individualClassifications.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
individualClassifications.reason: Standalone JUnit owns three workers with try-resource closure and finite10s Future waits. Each writeOne creates its own Jdbc; no Production/server task owner changed.

individualClassifications.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation
individualClassifications.reason: Jdbc.nullTypes is allocated with each per-call Jdbc, used only by that caller and its synchronous statement callbacks. Concurrent Test calls create separate Jdbc objects; no map crosses workers.

individualClassifications.message: In J2EE, getClassLoader() might not work as expected. Use Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() instead.
individualClassifications.reason: Own Test java.lang.reflect.Proxy uses the exact JDK Connection or PreparedStatement interface defining loader and same interface array, no TCCL/driver/provider change.
